verdict.rationale: Kimi's docs claim multi-file refactoring and whole-project refactoring in one pass, which is a form of acting on many items at once. The help center also lists an 'Agent cluster' (Agent集群) feature, but only as a headline. Nothing documents a general bulk-operation capability, such as selecting many items and applying one action to all of them. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch operation feature across arbitrary items, details of how Agent clusters parallelize work, limits on batch size, hands-on corroboration of bulk edits succeeding.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: A million-token context loads an entire large codebase with cross-module dependencies in one pass, enabling whole-project understanding and refactoring.
Best for large codebase analysis, multi-file refactoring, and long-document processing.
